rapport_notes: Empathetic handling of a customer's fear of being overcharged based on a bad past-mover experience; clean handoff to an in-person branch-manager walkthrough for a 3200 sq ft home.

evidence_quotes.agenda: not asked as the formal line, though the customer volunteered a real concern unprompted.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer: 'they charged me about twice what they said... we're kind of gun shy with movers.' Rep gave one substantive reassurance (professional movers, time-based billing, no hidden fees) with no further digging.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: we have a professionally train[ed] movers that are efficient...we don't have like a daily contracted workers (commit-to-rate/experience framing); no full estimate given since routed to walkthrough.

top_strength: Directly addressed the customer's stated fear of being overcharged (from a bad past experience) with specifics: no hidden fees, time-based billing, professional non-day-labor staff.
coaching_note: The formal 'biggest concerns' question was never asked — asking it up front would have surfaced the overcharge fear sooner and let the rep frame the walkthrough handoff around it directly.
